notes: Dated checkpoints. tools/check_review_dates.py fails after a date passes, so the weekly workflow opens an issue and a person re-checks the sources. A checkpoint is a prompt to re-read sources, not a prediction that anything will change. Remove or move a checkpoint only after doing the work, and say so in CHANGELOG.md.

checkpoints.what: A person reads every Utah page against its sources. The Utah guide was researched on Nov. 10, 2026 through a tool that answers questions about a page instead of returning its full text (docs/research-log.md), so nobody has yet read the Utah documents themselves end to end. Start with the numbers people act on: 90 and 15 days for hearings (U19), 30 days for the verification form (U04), 10 days for requested items (U16), the Jan. 1, 2027 date for tribal status proof (U28), and every phone, fax, and mailing address.

30-day re-check for both guides. Oregon: re-check OHA's pages (S01, S03, S07, and S24 by hand) for any response to the Oct. 29, 2026 court ruling; they had none on Nov. 10. Utah: re-check U01, U02, U03, and U04 for the same, and for form 742 and the medically frail screener being posted. Court: check the docket (S40) for a notice of appeal or any new order after the Oct. 29, 2026 judgment; none appeared through the Nov. 6 entries. Update C-COURT and U-COURT and their 'As of' dates on reasons.html, health.html, utah-reasons.html, and utah-health.html.

Before the Jan. 1, 2027 switch: re-read S01 (Oregon) and U02 (Utah) for any change to past medical bills (retroactive coverage). Then run python3 tools/check_review_dates.py --today 2027-01-02 and confirm the only expired notes it names are the Dec. 31 notes on index.html (2), bills.html (1), utah.html (2), and utah-bills.html (1).

After Jan. 1, 2027: delete the elements marked data-show-until="2026-12-31" on index.html, bills.html, utah.html, and utah-bills.html, so readers without JavaScript stop seeing them. Reword both home page titles and headlines ('New rules start Jan. 1, 2027') for a site read after the rules began. Utah: the letter on tribal status (U28) asked for proof by Jan. 1, 2027; check what Utah now says to people who have not sent it, and update U-AIAN-PROOF.

First check after the rules start. Oregon: re-read S01 to S09 and S24 by hand. Look for new OHA notices, forms (including any new version of OHP 7210), and any change to the 35-day reply window. Utah: re-read U01 to U05 and U14 to U16. Look for a new 61MED that asks about the rules, form 742, the medically frail screener, and what Utah's denial and verification letters are called.
Utah: DWS says the rules reach current members at reviews for renewals due in March 2027 or later (U04). Re-read U04 and U13, and decide whether the Utah guide needs renewal pages.
End of the court's six-month bar on penalizing plaintiff states (S28). Re-check the health reason and the case docket for appeals or new orders.
Utah: the glossary (U08) says Targeted Adult Medicaid ends June 30, 2027 and its members move to Adult Expansion Medicaid. Re-read U08, U25, and U26, and update every Utah page that names TAM.
Prepare for more frequent renewals in late 2027. Decide whether to add renewal pages for people who are now members.
Prepare for 2028 proof rules. Replace 'In 2027, no doctor's note is needed' with current OHA guidance.
